description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchQuery class in the SuiteCRM project. It verifies behavior such as string manipulation, encoding conversions, and request parsing for search queries.

classes.name: SearchQueryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the functionality of the SearchQuery class.

methods.name: testFromString
methods.description: Tests creation of a SearchQuery object from a string and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testIsEmpty
methods.description: Verifies the isEmpty method for non-empty and empty search queries.

methods.name: testTrim
methods.description: Tests trimming whitespace from the search string.

methods.name: testToLowerCase
methods.description: Checks conversion of the search string to lowercase.

methods.name: testReplace
methods.description: Tests replacing characters in the search string.

methods.name: testStripSlashes
methods.description: Verifies stripping of slashes from the search string.

methods.name: testEscapeRegex
methods.description: Tests escaping special regex characters in the search string.

methods.name: testConvertEncoding
methods.description: Verifies conversion of HTML entities and Unicode to corresponding characters.

methods.name: testFromRequestArray
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery from a request array.

methods.name: testFromRequestArray2
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery from a minimal request array and compares properties.

methods.name: testFromGetRequest
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery from the global $_GET array.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Provides a sample request array for testing.

methods.name: assertRequest
methods.description: Asserts that a SearchQuery object contains expected property values from a request.
